show.description: Humshakal is a suspenseful romantic thriller of deceit, power, and passion. When Kabir, a billionaire CEO, dies under mysterious circumstances, his secret twin brother Karan assumes his identity to uncover the truth. But as he gets entangled with Kabir's ruthless enemies and forbidden lovers, Karan realizes that stepping into his brother’s shoes may cost him not just his life—but also his heart.
